title: NotiVas v1.3.0
notes:
• Animated Startup Splash: Added an engaging Compose startup splash screen featuring a staggered dashboard entrance.
• Custom Assignment Reminders: Introduced support for scheduling custom reminders for assignments.
• Quick Dashboard Actions: Added a direct action to mark assignments as completed from the quick submenu.
• Inline Image Rendering: Enhanced draft rendering to support inline images with authenticated requests and refined format matching.
• Canvas Intent Prioritization: Prioritized the native Canvas Student app via intent when opening canvas URLs.
